spans.s:
घुष (इ) घुषि r. 1st cl. (घुंषते) To render beautiful or brilliant (इर) घुषिर
r. 1st cl. (घोषति) To do any act except manifest sentiment by
sound. r. 10th cl. (घोषयति)
 1. To manifest sentiment or thought by
sound, to speak, to affirm, to declare or proclaim.
 2. To make
various sounds.
 3. To praise. With आङ् prefixed, To weep in-
cessantly.

घुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Manifested by sound, proclaimed.
 E. घुष् as above,
affix क्त इट् augment; also घुष्ट.

घुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Sounded, proclaimed,
 E. घुष् to sound, क्त aff.

घुष्टान्न n. (-न्नं) Food given away by proclamation.
 E. घुष्ट and अन्न food.
घुष्टं को भोक्ता
घुष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) A car, a carriage.

घुसृण n. (-णं) Saffron.
 E. घुषि to beautify, ऋणक् aff.
